purpose: Validate GeoJSON plot geolocation for EUDR compliance: geometry type (Point or Polygon), coordinate range validity, EUDR size rule (plots >=4 ha require Polygon, Art. 9(1)(d)), polygon ring closure, and micro-operator postal-address exemption path. Returns valid verdict and issues list. Feeds commodity scope classifier (art-167). Zero network, zero PII. Reg. EU 2023/1115.
